description.value:
Homebrew: automatically applied whenever Breath Weapon (Kaiju) or any Dragon Breath spell is cast, matching both abilities' own real text -- "Once activated, it can't be used again for 1d4 rounds." Created by scripts/breath-weapon-recharge.js on the createChatMessage hook (matching this repo's own established pattern for detecting a specific spell cast), with a freshly-rolled 1d4 for its duration. Any previous copy of this effect on the same actor is deleted first rather than stacking a second one, so only one recharge timer is ever active at a time.

Your breath weapon is recharging and can't be used again until this expires.
